resources.string: Pages that travel like publications: fetched whole, readable offline, mirrored by readers who choose to. Nothing on a page can see you.
A ducat site is a sealed room — every image and style ships in the bundle, scripts stay off, and the only working links are ducat: ones. Paste an address to save one.
A link brought this address here. Adding saves it to your shelf; nothing is fetched until you open it.
That is not a ducat:site/ address.
Keep this site alive for others
Fetching — waiting for someone to serve it…
“%1$s” is yours. Deleting it here throws away the only key that can ever change it — the address keeps serving its last version to anyone still sharing it, and nothing can update it again.
